energy.accounting: semantic bytes and memory.* bytes overlap; never add as separate energy

mode_equivalence.fields: full trace, accept/complete, actual returned bytes, actions, final buffers/resources, all per-head state

model_boundary.V_schedule: all query weight/histogram writes finish, then explicit union barrier and ordered bounded prefetch
model_boundary.accumulation_order: each query visits its physical V token IDs in ascending order; each product and add round to FP32
model_boundary.cache: finite K/V rows held through every MAC consumer; timed shared read port plus finite operand slots held until MAC completion
model_boundary.omitted: QKV projection, RoPE, screening, Wo, dynamic KV append, full decoder, PPA/STA
model_boundary.physical_memory_reads: one DRAM read per physical token in each K or V union
model_boundary.scope: one KV head and explicit query head group; preprojected Q/K/V
model_boundary.source: one independent native-network state/seed bus per native sampled query; shared submit/delivery resources; no IID or shared-global-source claim
model_boundary.union: precompiled bounded K candidate directory; runtime V histogram scan and sorted-directory compaction use finite lanes and reserved metadata

numeric_scope: per-query exact weighted-V or retained-sample trajectory; no PPL or full-model accuracy
physical_status: configured uncharacterized cache/compute/clock contract; not STA, PPA or optimal streaming schedule
